# Azure Cost Optimizer Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > DevOps > Azure

## Overview

Optimizes Azure costs with reserved instances, Azure Advisor, and resource right-sizing for cloud financial management

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [azure-cost-optimizer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
azure-cost-optimizer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@azure-cost-optimizer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Analyze costs with Azure Cost Management
- Implement Azure Advisor recommendations
- Configure reserved instances and savings plans
- Identify underutilized resources for right-sizing

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Azure Cost Management**: Cost analysis and optimization
- **Azure Advisor**: Cost and performance recommendations
- **Reserved Instances**: Commitment-based pricing discounts
